issues.title: Unresolved External Dependency: Coding Guidelines
issues.why: AC-SD-01 and AC-SD-02 inherit core naming and typing rules from '../02-coding-guidelines/01-cross-language/97-acceptance-criteria.md', which is not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Provide the content of the referenced cross-language guidelines or inline the specific PascalCase and FK naming rules into §97.

issues.title: Missing Concurrency Handling for Non-Go Languages
issues.why: While AC-SD-22 provides a Go example and pseudo-code, the actual implementation files (01-fundamentals.md) only show Go code for WAL and connection pooling, leaving other languages to interpret the pseudo-code without concrete driver-specific setup examples.
issues.fix: Add a 'Polyglot Implementation' section to 01-fundamentals.md with the driver-specific connection strings for Python/TS/Rust mentioned in AC-SD-22.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'ProjectSlug' Source
issues.why: AC-SD-03 and AC-SD-25 refer to {ProjectSlug} in paths, but the Root DB schema in 01-fundamentals.md uses 'Slug' in the Project table and 'AppName' in the Application table (02-features/01-cli-examples.md), creating confusion on which registry table is the source of truth.
issues.fix: Standardize on a single registry table name (e.g., 'Project') and field name (e.g., 'Slug') across all examples and fundamentals.
